name: keyspaces
description: Amazon Keyspaces (for Apache Cassandra) is a scalable, highly available, and managed Apache Cassandra-compatible database service.

subcommands.name: create-keyspace
subcommands.description: The CreateKeyspace operation adds a new keyspace to your account.

subcommands.name: create-table
subcommands.description: The CreateTable operation adds a new table to the specified keyspace.

subcommands.name: create-type
subcommands.description: The CreateType operation creates a new user-defined type in the specified keyspace.

subcommands.name: delete-keyspace
subcommands.description: The DeleteKeyspace operation deletes a keyspace and all of its tables.

subcommands.name: delete-table
subcommands.description: The DeleteTable operation deletes a table and all of its data.

subcommands.name: delete-type
subcommands.description: The DeleteType operation deletes a user-defined type (UDT).

subcommands.name: get-keyspace
subcommands.description: Returns the name of the specified keyspace, the Amazon Resource Name (ARN), the replication strategy, the Amazon Web Services Regions of a multi-Region keyspace, and the status of newly added Regions after an UpdateKeyspace operation.

subcommands.name: get-table
subcommands.description: Returns information about the table, including the table's name and current status, the keyspace name, configuration settings, and metadata.

subcommands.name: get-table-auto-scaling-settings
subcommands.description: Returns auto scaling related settings of the specified table in JSON format.

subcommands.name: get-type
subcommands.description: The GetType operation returns information about the type, for example the field definitions, the timestamp when the type was last modified, the level of nesting, the status, and details about if the type is used in other types and tables.

subcommands.name: list-keyspaces
subcommands.description: The ListKeyspaces operation returns a list of keyspaces.

subcommands.name: list-tables
subcommands.description: The ListTables operation returns a list of tables for a specified keyspace.

subcommands.name: list-tags-for-resource
subcommands.description: Returns a list of all tags associated with the specified Amazon Keyspaces resource.

subcommands.name: list-types
subcommands.description: The ListTypes operation returns a list of types for a specified keyspace.

subcommands.name: restore-table
subcommands.description: Restores the table to the specified point in time within the earliest_restorable_timestamp and the current time.

subcommands.name: tag-resource
subcommands.description: Associates a set of tags with a Amazon Keyspaces resource.

subcommands.name: untag-resource
subcommands.description: Removes the association of tags from a Amazon Keyspaces resource.

subcommands.name: update-keyspace
subcommands.description: Adds a new Amazon Web Services Region to the keyspace.

subcommands.name: update-table
subcommands.description: Adds new columns to the table or updates one of the table's settings, for example capacity mode, auto scaling, encryption, point-in-time recovery, or ttl settings.
